description: This file defines the CenterSheetPopulator class responsible for populating an Excel worksheet with data about centers and offices in the Fineract project. It manages mapping offices to centers, creating the sheet layout, and filling in center details dynamically.

classes.name: CenterSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with data about centers and their associated offices, used for bulk import/export operations in Fineract.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates and populates the center sheet in the workbook, setting up layout and data.

methods.name: centerNameToCenterIdMap
methods.description: Builds a mapping from center names to their unique IDs.

methods.name: populateCentersByOfficeName
methods.description: Fills the sheet with centers grouped under their respective offices.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Initializes the sheet header and column widths.

methods.name: setOfficeToCentersMap
methods.description: Prepares a map from office names to lists of center names.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Helper method to add a center name to the list associated with an office in the map.
